snippet.title: Potato Cop - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
You’re a potato. With a badge. And a peeler.

Welcome to Potato Cop— an action bullet hell where you beat the mash out of rogue potatoes.

In a world where other enemies shoot projectiles, leave burning trails, attack with teamwork. You and your trusty peeler will HURT THEIR PEELINGS!!!

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3605550/Potato_Cop/

#IndieGame #BulletHell #SteamGame #PotatoCop #IndieDev #JavascriptGame
